note: Two ontologies and the join between them. The article side says what a piece of news contains; the audience side says what a role watches for; the join says why one reached the other, and — as importantly — why one did not. Adapted from the grammar pt.newsroom.sgit.ai uses for the Portuguese graph, with its rule kept: every edge is a verb with a distinct named inverse, and a path that does not read as a sentence is a wrong edge. The first rule is the one the others serve: this is built to be corrected, not to be right.

rules.rule: The ontology does not have to be right. It has to be wrong in ways a human reader can see and correct.
rules.why: Correctness is not available: nobody can write a complete taxonomy of what six roles care about, and waiting until it is right means never publishing. Legibility IS available — every classification shown with its working out, every concern that fires on everything or fires on nothing surfaced as a question rather than buried in a score. This rule outranks the others: where a modelling choice is more correct but less checkable, take the checkable one, and where the corpus contradicts the ontology, the corpus is right.

rules.rule: Every edge is a verb with a distinct named inverse, and both directions read as sentences.
rules.why: An edge you cannot read aloud in both directions is usually two different claims wearing one label.

rules.rule: No symmetric verb. Where a relation genuinely is symmetric, reify it as a node.
rules.why: A symmetric verb is its own inverse, which means it carries no direction and therefore no information. `contradicts` is the case that matters here: two sources disagreeing is a Discrepancy node, which can then be dated, sourced and pointed at.

rules.rule: Classification is a published formula or it does not happen.
rules.why: The entire argument of this site is that a recommendation must be checkable. A selection rule nobody can read is the black box in a different coat.

rules.rule: An article NOT reaching an audience is recorded with the same structure as one that does.
rules.why: Any system can explain what it chose. Explaining what it rejected, and why, is the harder half and the one a reader actually doubts.

article.note: What a piece of news contains. Deliberately small: a type earns its place by being something at least one audience watches for, and every type here is named in at least one concern.

types.label: Article
types.definition: One published piece, in its original language.

types.label: Claim
types.definition: A single assertion the article makes, which walks back to a frozen source.

types.label: Source
types.definition: A frozen, hashed copy of the page a claim rests on. Evidence, not a page of this site.

types.label: Organisation
types.definition: A named company, institution or body.

types.label: Person
types.definition: A named individual, in a professional capacity only.

types.label: Event
types.definition: A dated, located happening: a conference, a deadline, an incident.

types.label: Programme
types.definition: A funding call, accelerator or scheme somebody can apply to.

types.label: Instrument
types.definition: A law, regulation, designation or formal decision.

types.label: Obligation
types.definition: A duty an instrument creates, and who it binds.

types.label: Technology
types.definition: A named product, protocol, model or version.

types.label: Weakness
types.definition: A way something fails or can be made to fail.

types.label: Control
types.definition: A change to a system that reduces a weakness.

types.label: Sector
types.definition: A population of organisations treated as one.

types.label: Measure
types.definition: A count or rate, with the thing it counts and the date it was true.

types.label: Money
types.definition: An amount, with what it was for.

types.label: Discrepancy
types.definition: Two sources answering the same question differently. A node, not an edge, so it can be dated and pointed at.

forbidden.why: Symmetric: A contradicts B is B contradicts A, so it is its own inverse and carries no direction. Use a Discrepancy node, which can also be dated and sourced.
Says nothing a reader could check, and absorbs every edge that was too much trouble to name properly.
True of almost every pair and therefore useless for selection. If it matters, the specific verb exists.
This is the conclusion, not an edge. Writing it as an edge hides the reasoning the join exists to expose.

audience.note: What a role watches for. Small on purpose: the audience side is the half a human maintains by hand, and a taxonomy nobody can hold in their head stops being maintained and starts being wrong.

types.label: Audience
types.definition: One of the six roles this site publishes for.

types.label: Concern
types.definition: A thing an audience watches for, declared as the article types that satisfy it.

types.label: Currency
types.definition: What this audience converts a piece of news into. The reason two audiences given the same article produce different pieces rather than different lengths.

types.label: Axis
types.definition: A named spectrum audiences sit on: mechanism wanted, scope, horizon.

types.label: Qualifier
types.definition: A type that must ALSO be present in the article for a concern to fire. The difference between 'this audience cares about source integrity' and 'this audience cares about source integrity in technical material'.

join.note: The two worlds meet here, and this is the only part of the system a reader needs to trust. A Connection is a node rather than an edge so that it can be pointed at, dated, disagreed with and — the case that matters — counted when there are none.

types.label: Delivery
types.definition: One article considered for one audience. Exists whether or not the article reached it: a withheld delivery is a result, not an absence.

types.label: Connection
types.definition: One reason an article reached an audience: which entity, which concern, by what match, and the sentence that says so.

formula.statement: For every article A and every audience U, a Delivery exists. A concern declaring `requires` is skipped unless A also contains a qualifying type. For each remaining concern C and each entity E in A's graph, a match is attempted; every match found becomes a Connection. The Delivery is `reached` if it holds at least one Connection and `withheld` otherwise. Rank counts each ENTITY once, at its strongest match — summing every connection lets one entity score repeatedly through overlapping concerns, which it did the first time this formula ran.

matches.when: A concern declaring `requires` does not fire at all unless the article also contains one of the qualifying types. Applied before any other match.
matches.reads: {audience} watches {concern}, but only where the article also concerns {qualifiers}; this one does not.

matches.when: E's type is named directly in C's satisfied-by list.
matches.reads: {audience} watches {concern}; the article names {entity}, which is a {type}.

matches.when: E's type is one hop below a type named in C, in the published taxonomy.
E's type is one hop above a type named in C. Weakest match, because a broader thing may not carry the specific consequence the audience is watching for.
matches.reads: {audience} watches {concern}; {entity} is the wider category of {type}.

matches.when: A path of at most two article edges runs from E to something C names — and the path reads as a sentence.

formula.withheld_reason: A withheld Delivery records which concerns were tried and why each failed: either the audience watches for types this article has none of, or the only matches available were below threshold. 'Nothing matched' is not an acceptable reason on its own.

threshold.note: One connection is enough to reach, deliberately. Ranking, not filtering, is what handles a weak connection — a feed that silently drops items cannot be audited, and an item at the bottom of a ranked list can be.

formula.honest_note: In the running pipeline the matches are PROPOSED by a language model comparing two graphs — that is stage 3 of the MyFeeds architecture. This formula does not replace that; it constrains the shape of what comes back so that every proposed match is recorded with its type, its weight, its two endpoints and a sentence, and can therefore be disagreed with by a human reading the delivery. The model proposes; the formula records and scores; the reader checks. Where the two sides of a match are identical concept ids, no model is needed at all and the match is computed.
